cues.en: What is the formula for the volume of a sphere? Four thirds pi times the radius cubed. 1.26.
cues.zh: 球体积的公式是什么？三分之四π乘以半径的立方。1.26。

cues.en: Dimensionality equals logarithm and divided by...... Excludability and non rival...... Thirds pi times... When is an action sentence?... Is morally praiseworthy, but not morally obligatory.
cues.zh: 维度等于对数除以……排他性和非竞争性……三分之四π乘以……一个行为句子是什么时候？……在道德上值得赞扬，但并非道德上必须履行的。
